intent.proves: Every feed on the template provider states a non-empty Content Type in its provider configuration.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.reason: Requires complete joins and raw/fallback semantics parity before this binding may execute.

bindings.query: SELECT CAST(FeedId AS nvarchar(20)) + N' ' + CAST(FeedName AS nvarchar(200)) FROM EcomFeed WHERE ISNULL(FeedIsFolder, 0) = 0 AND FeedProvider LIKE N'%TemplateProvider%' AND (CAST(FeedProviderConfiguration AS nvarchar(max)) NOT LIKE N'%name=' + CHAR(34) + N'Content Type' + CHAR(34) + N'%' OR CAST(FeedProviderConfiguration AS nvarchar(max)) LIKE N'%name=' + CHAR(34) + N'Content Type' + CHAR(34) + N' value=' + CHAR(34) + CHAR(34) + N'%')
